verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Devin CLI routes prompts among its own models via Adaptive and lets users switch to a specific model with /model. That is model selection, an adjacent feature. Nothing shows users can bring their own LLM, endpoint or API key, so the story is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice
